idea: Enterprise container security scanning platform — multi-engine correlation (Grype/Trivy/Syft), threat-intel enrichment (KEV/EPSS), AI triage, policy gates, compliance and OpenVEX reporting.

exitCriteria: Every user story has >=1 acceptance criterion phrased as a verifiable check
Every story has a MoSCoW priority
Non-goals section exists and is non-empty
Open questions listed with owner (user) - none silently resolved
requirements.summary: 94 reverse-engineered stories over 21 capability areas; 70 shipped, 5 partial, 19 gap; 11 open questions blocking.
requirements.reviewVerdict: Adversarial PM review found 40 (8 critical, 17 required, 15 nit); all 40 addressed in one fix round; 4 criticals independently re-verified against source by the main session. No unresolved critical.

exitCriteria: Risk register has >=3 risks, each with likelihood, impact, mitigation
Any 'needs spike' item has a time-boxed spike task listed for the plan stage
feasibility.summary: GO WITH CONDITIONS. 15 risks, 5 spikes (6.5d), 10 ADRs required. 3 Must stories judged not deliverable this cycle (WK-3, SY-6, SY-9). 4 open questions block Must work directly.
feasibility.reviewVerdict: Adversarial review found 11 (3 critical, 6 required, 2 nit); all 11 addressed. 3 criticals independently re-verified by the main session, including a wrong '97 of 115 untested' figure this document had mis-tagged as verified. No unresolved critical.

exitCriteria: Every backlog task has acceptance criteria + a verification command
Dependencies form a valid order (no cycles, no forward references)
Milestones each end in demonstrable working software
plan.summary: 44 tasks across 8 milestones and 8 checkpoints. 5 spikes, 6 ADRs, characterization harness as task zero. WK-3/SY-6/SY-9 out of cycle. T-44 blocked on a compliance retention window from the user.
plan.reviewVerdict: Adversarial architect review found 30 (5 critical, 21 required, 4 nit); all addressed. 3 criticals independently re-verified, incl. dashboard/src/api.js:304 hardcoding ws://host:7070 with no credential - shipping AU-10 without the paired client change would have killed live scan progress for every user.

exitCriteria: Every plan-stage backlog task maps to a component in the design
>=3 numbered ADRs (stack choice, data storage, deployment shape at minimum)
Every API contract names request/response types exactly
Security section addresses every trust boundary the threat model found
design.summary: 20 binding ADRs. ADR-8 decides DO NOT SPLIT routes_v2.py, so plan Branch B is the executing graph and T-11 is void. 7 sections, all 44 plan tasks mapped, 3 plan/code gaps flagged to BA.
design.reviewVerdict: Security threat model (3 critical, 8 required) + adversarial review (1 critical, 4 required) = 4 critical, 12 required, 4 nit; all addressed, 5 independently re-verified. Two findings were defects in the design itself: ADR-6 purged audit_log at 30 days (would destroy the SY-8 evidence it exists to protect) and the edge nginx has no WebSocket Upgrade headers at all, so T-20 was unreachable through the edge. No unresolved critical.
flaggedToUser: audit_log retention window is unstated - purge now excludes it and it retains indefinitely until a window is given
T-31 first verify clause is vacuous (auth.py:277 writes role on every key); only the S4 reconciliation is a real test

decisions: OQ-11 answered 2026-08-02: reports stay readable by any authenticated user (main.py:103-108 design stands). AU-8 drops Must->Should and is largely cosmetic; EX-3 acceptance criterion is unchanged.

OQ-7 answered 2026-08-02: API keys gain role+owner; existing keys grandfathered as admin. No pipeline breaks. Cross-tenant exposure persists until every key is rotated, so a rotation task is required alongside the code change.

OQ-5 answered 2026-08-02: compliance output is or will be audit evidence. Escalation applies - SY-8 rises Should->Must, compliance.py:23 thresholds must become configurable, AU-9 becomes a compliance dependency.
OQ-3 answered 2026-08-02: Postgres retention matches the 30-day Redis SCAN_RESULT_TTL.

Compliance retention window answered 2026-08-02: 30 days, equal to the operational window. T-44 unblocked. Forces ARTIFACT_RETENTION_DAYS 7 -> 30 (config.py:148) so report/SBOM files do not expire 23 days before the record they evidence. ACCEPTED RESIDUAL RISK: a 30-day window cannot evidence an annual audit; raised twice and reaffirmed.
T-31 (production API key rotation) owner assigned 2026-08-02: devops-ops. This is the task that actually closes the AU-6 cross-tenant exposure - the code change in T-30 only makes it possible.
